title: A living story leaves an old opening

captions.physics: Speaking of wanted freedom to approach
captions.energy: Ending an exhausted way of beginning

meaning: You can speak of wanted freedom to approach each other and end an exhausted conversational opening, feeling warmth in interest that no longer needs a familiar justification.
text: The Star in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in talking about wanted freedom to approach each other. Death in energy supports readiness to end an exhausted conversational opening and leave a formula that has lost its actual meaning. The Empress in emotions brings warmth as interest in a story grows. You can hope for a livelier exchange and abandon an unnecessary introduction. This ending concerns speech rather than predicting closeness’s future.

For example, you discuss how good it would be to stop beginning every small story with “Sorry to interrupt”. Now readiness to listen can be asked about directly before sharing an interesting detail. **Living interest does not always need an old justification**. Curiosity answers, and the story develops further details. Warmth concerns the actual exchange rather than proving compulsory availability at every moment. Leaving an empty apology does not prevent hearing an honest “I cannot right now” or preserving interest in a possible continuation. The opening changes without assigning an unlimited promise to either person.

Difficulty arises if leaving one formula becomes a ban on every careful approach. Warm conversation supposedly has to begin without checking readiness. Constructive Death energy helps leave what is exhausted without erasing useful attention to an actual reply. You can speak directly and ask about time with care; living interest requires neither constant justification for your words nor certainty that every approach will meet equal readiness.
